title: ISERROR ( 0 / 0 ) is TRUE: ISERROR counts NaN as an error

source.quote: ISERROR also returns TRUE when the value is positive infinity, negative infinity or NaN (not a number). For example, 1 / 0, -1 / 0 and 0 / 0 return these values
source.supports: stated outright, and the page's example shows TRUE for ISERROR of 1 / 0

notes: DAX Guide also says ISERROR cannot catch every runtime error, depending on the execution plan. The page's example shows TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE for 1 / 0, -1 / 0, 0 / 0, DIVIDE ( 1, 0 ), DIVIDE ( 0, 0 ).
